target_customer: E-commerce and subscription businesses that lose revenue to churn, abandoned signups and failed onboarding
problem: Companies lose 5 to 15 percent of revenue monthly to churn and drop-offs, and win-back emails and cancel flows do not work; Boom runs proactive outbound conversations over SMS, email, WhatsApp and phone.
business_model: B2B SaaS / AI agent platform, pricing not found
product_category: Conversational AI agents for revenue recovery and customer engagement

founders.name: Juan Casian
previous_startups: Atrato, Latin American buy now pay later company, scaled to roughly 20M dollars annualized revenue and acquired (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Started at Atrato as CTO and became CEO per the YC page.

founders.name: Jose Toscano
founders.background_notes: Leads AI work per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Multichannel conversational agents with shared memory, guardrails and SOC 2 Type II claims are standard LLM engineering with hard parts around reliability and compliance of outbound messaging.

defensibility.rationale: Agent platforms on top of commodity models are easy to copy; accumulated conversation data and channel integrations give limited stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Voice and chat platforms already offered win-back templates; no outcome recorded for Boom.

market_need_then: Subscription and e-commerce firms face churn and abandoned carts; the company's origin story at Atrato reportedly involved not being able to interview enough customers (YesPress, May 2026 update, unverified).

branding.domain_note: Uses useboom.ai, not boom.com or boom.ai.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct benefit-led copy such as 'Boom reaches out to your customers before you lose them' and the line 'AI workforce for your customers'.

branding.community_and_virality: None found; many unrelated companies named Boom share search results.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with several other Boom companies and no brand coverage found; the useboom.ai domain signals the exact name was unavailable.

outcome_analysis: Boom is a three person Fall 2025 YC company by repeat founders from Atrato, a YC W21 company that scaled to about 20 million dollars annualized revenue and was acquired according to the YC page. It sells AI agents that recover churned and abandoned customers and names a few customers. No verified funding, traction or exit data was found, so the outcome is open.
notes: Funding unverified: one startup directory lists a 500K dollar seed dated 2025-09 from Y Combinator (a YC standard deal, not recorded as a round).
